settings.reference_x: numpy.linalg.solve on the assembled dense matrix

header.notes: Dimensionless. Blocks are row-major m*m, stored back to back: lower[k] = block (k+1,k), upper[k] = block (k,k+1), diag has nb blocks. 'b' and 'x' are lists of right-hand sides / solutions. 'dominance' = max_i(||M_i^-1 L||+||M_i^-1 U||) in the inf-norm (< 1 required, asserted). 'param': A(p) = A0 + p A1, b(p) = b0 + p b1; dx = A^-1 (b1 - A1 x), checked by central differences (h=1e-6).
